title: Clarifying a Task at Work
title_zh: 工作中澄清任务与求助
context: 同事 Ella 和 Noah 正在准备每周销售表。Ella 不理解如何筛选本周数据，请 Noah 示范；她复述步骤、截止时间和发送给 Noah 核对的下一步。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: I am working on the weekly sales table, but I do not understand the filter step.
dialogue.zh: 我正在做每周销售表，但不明白筛选这一步。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: The filter lets you show only this week's entries.
dialogue.zh: 筛选功能可以让你只显示本周的条目。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Could you show me how to do that?
dialogue.zh: 你能示范一下怎么做吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Sure. Click the date filter, then select this week.
dialogue.zh: 当然。点击日期筛选，再选择本周。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: I see. Do I save the filtered table as a new file?
dialogue.zh: 我明白了。我要把筛选后的表格另存为新文件吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Yes. Save a copy, then send it to me to check.
dialogue.zh: 是的。保存一个副本，然后发给我核对。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: Let me check: filter for this week, save a copy, and send it to you.
dialogue.zh: 我确认一下：筛选本周数据，保存副本，然后发给你。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: That is right. Please send it by three this afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 对。请在今天下午三点前发给我。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: You will have it by three today. I will send it to you first.
dialogue.zh: 你今天三点前就能收到。我会先把它发给你。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Exactly. I will check it before we share it with the team.
dialogue.zh: 没错。我会在我们分享给团队之前核对。

dialogue.speaker: Ella
dialogue.en: I have applied the filter and saved the copy. I will send it now.
dialogue.zh: 我已经筛选并保存了副本，现在发给你。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Thanks, Ella. I will look for it and let you know after I check it.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢，Ella。我会留意接收，核对后告诉你。

expressions.zh: 筛选出符合条件的数据；常用于表格。
你能示范一下怎么做吗？不理解步骤时可以使用。
expressions.example: Could you show me how to use the filter?

expressions.zh: 保存一个副本；保留原文件并另存一份。
expressions.example: Please save a copy before you send it.

expressions.zh: 我确认一下；复述前用来核对理解。
expressions.example: Let me check: you need it by three?

expressions.zh: 三点前，最迟三点；by 表示截止时间。
expressions.example: Please send me the table by three.

pronunciation: filter /ˈfɪltər/ 重音在第一音节，末尾 /r/ 可轻卷舌；copy /ˈkɑːpi/ 重音在第一音节。说 by three 时，注意 three 的 /θ/：舌尖轻触上下齿之间。

practice.title: Part 1 · Learning at work
practice.prompt: What do you do when you do not understand a task?
practice.answer: I ask a coworker to show me the step I do not understand. Then I explain it back to make sure I can do it.

practice.title: Part 2 · Learning a task
practice.prompt: Describe a task someone helped you learn. Say what the task was, what help you received, and what you did next.
practice.answer: At work I once needed to prepare a weekly sales table. I did not know how to filter the dates, so I asked a coworker to show me. He clicked the date filter and selected the current week. I repeated the steps and checked when he needed the file. Then I saved a copy and sent it to him before the deadline. His explanation helped me feel more confident. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Asking for help
practice.prompt: How can coworkers make it easier to ask for help?
practice.answer: They can listen without making someone feel embarrassed and demonstrate one step at a time. Checking the deadline and the next action also helps everyone understand the task.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 先逐句跟读，再说明一个不懂的工作步骤，请同伴示范并复述截止时间与下一步。
practice.answer: 用 4–6 句练习；同伴示范后，你确认步骤、交付对象和时间。
